headline: Gold dips slightly today; silver down about 14% since late October
summary: Gold 24K moved only ₹1 lower today to ₹13,679 per gram, a negligible change, but it is down about 4.1% (₹590) from a week ago and about 4.2% over the last 23 days. Silver fell ₹100 per kg today to ₹1,89,900, but has dropped about 7.4% in the past week and about 13.7% since 26 October, when it stood at ₹2,20,000. The likely drivers are movements in international prices and the US dollar against the rupee, though the data here does not establish a specific cause.
outlook: Prices have fallen steadily over the past three weeks, so if you are buying for a wedding or festival, there is no urgency today; you may prefer to watch for a few more days before committing, and remember GST and making charges sit on top of these rates.
